initialization_strategy: SVD-based weight initialization maximizing gradient alignment
mechanistic_notes: Uses gradient information from current network to compute SVD of gradient matrix.
New weights are set to top singular vectors scaled to match gradient norm.
Existing weights are frozen during growth to prevent disturbance of learned behavior.
Growth occurs at scheduled intervals without reinitializing optimizer states.
selection_criterion: select neurons with highest projected gradient magnitude via top singular vectors
summary: GradMax grows neural networks during training by adding neurons whose weights are initialized via an SVD-based procedure to maximize useful gradient signals, preserving existing learned behavior.
website_alignment_notes: Description matches the paper's abstract style, focusing on mechanistic growth procedure rather than performance marketing.
